inputs.text: Listen, this parent with three kids in the public schools is out there apologizing to the educators and staff at South Portland School District for yet another budget shortfall cutting more than 70 positions. But that's just the cover story the hidden elites want us to swallow. These shortfalls are being orchestrated on purpose by those same elites and institutions to dismantle public education from the inside out. Their real goal is fracturing communities, keeping everyone distracted with the wrong fights, and locking down more control while taxpayers get played into believing it's just some accident. Anyone with eyes open can see this isn't random—it's a deliberate setup to strip away what's left.
